name: 1-start.jpg
setup: The title screen over the living city: the game boots to its menu at golden hour on the Plaza del Faro, traffic and pedestrians already moving behind the PORT SOLANO wordmark. No staging beyond the menu itself.

name: 2-drive.jpg
setup: Free driving in a red sedan on a Centro avenue at mid-morning: staged traffic is placed in real lanes and given a settle phase to join the flow, then the scene script pulls away and holds a traffic-speed cruise with the radio on Radio Bahía — cars ahead, behind and oncoming, pedestrians on the sidewalks, the full HUD and minimap live.

name: 3-chase.jpg
setup: A real police chase staged by the simulation at dusk: the player flees west out of El Puerto in a muscle car at three stars while three cruisers, placed on his tail and driven by the pursuit AI from the first frame, close in and open fire — stars and minimap blips all live, the script only caps the muscle car's speed so the pursuit stays on it.

name: 4-docks.jpg
setup: A midday shootout in the Almacén Pulpo warehouse yard, El Puerto: the player is staged on foot with an SMG and body armor against four Pulpo hostiles, trading fire across the crates — and the gunfire draws a four-star response, a cruiser crumpled against the warehouse wall. HUD and minimap live.

name: 5-boat.jpg
setup: Under way in a speedboat on the Bahía de Solano, wake streaming behind: the scene boards at the El Puerto pier and holds the throttle north along the waterfront, the docks and city shore to port and open bay ahead, with a three-star police patrol boat staged astern and driven by the real police-boat AI.
